description: Singappullige Mallika Kusumalatha v. General Manager, Electrical, Ceylon Electricity Board & Others Singappullige Mallika Kusumalatha v. General Manager, Electrical, Ceylon Electricity Board & Others View More before Hon. A.H.M.D. Nawaz, J
parties: Singappullige Mallika Kusumalatha v. General Manager, Electrical, Ceylon Electricity Board & Others Singappullige Mallika Kusumalatha v. General Manager, Electrical, Ceylon Electricity Board & Others View More
keywords: Mandamus – Electricity pole situated on petitioner’s land – Agreement following site inspection to relocate pole – Public Utilities Commission approving relocation – Ceylon Electricity Board unable to implement because of obstruction by private respondent – Statutory enforcement remedy through Magistrate’s Court – CEB undertaking to invoke that remedy – Petitioner thereafter withdrawing application – Proceedings dismissed/terminated subject to undertaking. P. Padman Surasena J. agreed.
legistation: Sri Lanka Electricity Act No. 20 of 2009 – section 39(1) and Schedule 2, section 9; Constitution – Article 140.
